summary: Robo.ai Inc., a Dubai-based Nasdaq-listed technology group, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that majority-owned subsidiary ALIF Holding plans to establish ALIF Composites as a majority-owned UAE subsidiary. Production is targeted for Q4 2026, with planned annual capacity of 10 million square meters of composite raw materials by 2027, operating at ALIF Holding's Umm Al Quwain industrial park where Phase I broke ground September 25, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is an ordinary business-expansion announcement, not a special situation; watch for funding, permits, and commissioning risk against forward-looking capacity claims.
